decisions.reason: The firm only mentions the workstation on its website, so its public commitment is low, but it was launched just a year ago, the development cost is already spent, and any weak early sales can still be blamed on a market ramp-up, so management keeps it.

The thermal inkjet printer has its own dedicated web page and fits the firm's announced marking and coding direction, so management will keep it rather than reverse its visible commitment after one year.
The piezo inkjet printer has a dedicated web page, completes the high-resolution inkjet line together with B, and represents substantial sunk investment, so it is kept.
